Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Harpers
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Empower

A safe house hidden near your Bastion, linked to it by a tunnel no more than a quarter mile long. Your hireling keeps it under a cover identity that doesn't lead back to your Bastion. You can move it each time you gain a level.

Hideout Defenses. The hideout is constantly protected by the Alarm spell. At level 9, a magic doorway can replace the tunnel (passing through a door of the hideout leads to a specific door of your Bastion, and vice versa), and the hideout can be anywhere within 100 miles of your Bastion; at level 13, anywhere in Faerûn; at level 17, the doorway works across planes and the hideout can be anywhere in the multiverse.

Empower: Harper Training. The hireling invites a nearby Harper agent. Roll any die: on an odd number, nothing comes of it; on an even number, a Friendly Harper stays in your hideout for 7 days. Any character who trains with them at least 8 hours on each of those days gains proficiency in Deception, Investigation, or Performance (their choice) for 7 days. The Harper won't defend your Bastion and leaves at once if it is attacked.

Source: Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerûn.
